def transform(grid):

    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]

    def segments(n, bars):
        out, start = [], 0
        for b in bars:
            out.append((start, b))
            start = b + 1
        out.append((start, n))
        return out

    rs, cs = segments(h, sep_rows), segments(w, sep_cols)
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rs for c0, c1 in cs
              if r1 > r0 and c1 > c0]
    if not panels:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The original motif is the panel with the most cells unlike the canvas
    # color; repeated blank panels are filled from this source.
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != bg
                                           for r in range(p[0], p[1])

    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
